issue_body: I'm using the compact number formatter for big counts and some values come out looking wrong - the decimals don't seem right. Can you fix it so numbers format properly?
prompt: This build adds a custom number helper, Math.compact(n: number): string, that formats a number into a short, human-readable form for display. I'm using it for big counts and some values come out looking wrong - the decimals don't seem right. Can you figure out what's going on and fix it so numbers format properly?
expected_behavior: Compact-formatted numbers come out correctly across a range of values.
skills_tested: inferring an undocumented contract from source code
finding unmentioned defects beyond the one reported symptom
rounding, boundary, and sign reasoning across multiple helper methods
distinguishing the hinted symptom from independent latent bugs
